notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app help) evaluating Redwood. Started with Hosted API trial (Q4 2025) for proof-of-concept; now moving to Dedicated POC to meet enterprise SLAs and residency requirements.

Recent timeline: 
- 2025-11-03: inbound trial signup; engineering trial account created. basic integration (chat + embeddings).
- 2025-12-08: product demo (hosted) with Priya, Head of Product, and Eng Lead (Marco joined). outcome: impressed by latency, asked about dedicated capacity + VPC.
- 2026-01-14: security questionnaire submitted (baseline SOC2 + SSO required).
- 2026-02-15: discovery call (FF-20260215-0900) — discussed throughput targets and routing.
- 2026-03-01: pricing review + POC scope call (FF-20260301-1215). finance signaled need for ARR estimate to approve committed Dedicated spend.
- 2026-03-10: internal approvals for POC budget (prelim). scheduled Dedicated POC kickoff.

POC objective: validate Dedicated deployment with canary + fallback routing for critical support-agent flows and document search. Demonstrate predictable tail-latency under load and safe rollback on regressions.

Requirements / targets (customer-provided):
- workload: conversational support agent (~60% chat, 30% retrieval/embeddings, 10% reranking)
- latency SLO: median < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for short-context responses (<=512 tokens)
- throughput target: baseline 120 reqs/sec with bursts up to 400 for promotion events
- cost sensitivity: moderate — want to reduce per-token cost vs Hosted over sustained load but keep fallback to Hosted for peak overflow
- model preferences: primary: vetted open-chat model (Llama2-Chat-like), quantized dedicated variant (8-bit) for cost; fallback: Redwood hosted high-availability model (multi-tenant)
- residency: US data residency for storage and KMS in scope

Planned Dedicated POC runbook (high level):
- Phase 0 (Prep): exchange firewall/VPC peering details, run connectivity smoke tests, onboarding of infra ops (target 2 weeks)
- Phase 1 (Canary deploy): route 5% of production traffic to Dedicated pool for 48h; compare latencies, error rates, token costs. Canary success criteria: error rate delta <= 0.5% vs hosted baseline, p95 latency improvement >= 10%, no correctness regressions on eval set.
- Phase 2 (Ramp): if canary passes, increase to 25% for 24–72h, run load test to reach 120 req/s baseline. monitor KV cache hit rates and batching efficiency.
- Phase 3 (Failover/region tests): simulate region failover (US-East -> US-West) and verify routing policies; confirm auto-fallback to Hosted API when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Phase 4 (Rollback / Cutover): define rollback triggers (error increase >1% sustained 10m, latency >2x baseline sustained 10m, eval-quality drop on prompt set) and automated routing rollback plan.

Routing & fallback design notes:
- model variants: dedicated-quantized-v1 (primary), dedicated-accurate-v1 (higher-cost fallback within Dedicated), hosted-HA (final fallback)
- policy: prefer Dedicated primary in region; fall back to hosted-HA if Dedicated queueing > threshold or per-request cost budget exceeded; region failover for region-level outage; health checks every 10s with 5s timeout.
- observability: trace-level token latency, per-route cost, model-version tag in all logs, and regressions tied to prompt test set (provided by customer).

Security & compliance:
- customer requires SSO/SAML for console access, KMS integration for key wrapping of any persistent embeddings, and audit logs retained for 1 year.
- current gap: KMS team needs exact HSM endpoint and IAM roles; vault integration ticket RRD-1130 opened.

Quotes / call highlights: 
- "We need predictable latency for our enterprise tier — can't have spikes during release windows." — Head of Product (Priya).
- "If Dedicated reduces our unit cost by ~20% at steady state we can justify a 12-month commitment." — Finance lead.

Next steps (short):

- Customer: provide CIDR blocks, KMS contact, and final list of 100 test prompts for regression checks.
- Schedule infra call (SE + infra ops + customer) for week of 2026-03-18.

Open blockers: budget alignment for Dedicated commit (finance), VPC peering windows, KMS key access timing.
